component.name: Snap64 Recomp
component.summary: Pokémon Snap, the N64 game, as a native PC program

description.p: Snap64 Recomp is a native port of Pokémon Snap (Nintendo 64, US release) made by static recompilation: the game's own code runs on the PC, the port only hosts it. It plays like the cartridge by default; every enhancement is off until turned on in the game's own Options screen: widescreen, higher resolution, frame interpolation, mouse and gyro aim, button rebinding, fast forward, photo export, mods and texture packs, and the Snap Station's printer.
No game data is included. You need your own cartridge dump of the US game; the program asks for it on the first start and copies it into its own folder.
